arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id GROUP BY c.card_type ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, c.card_type
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions for each card type (Credit, Debit, Debit (Prepaid)), from most to fewest.
assumptions: 'Type of card' read as cards.card_type (Credit, Debit, Debit (Prepaid)), not card brand.
All transactions counted, labelled or not, including those with negative amounts or errors.
